title: Doctor Strange Keeps Saving Her. Why Does She Still Die?
description: The tragedy of Doctor Strange in What If…? season 1 episode 4 (2021). This is alternate animated continuity, not the 2016 movie or a prediction about later films.
hook: Doctor Strange can reverse time. So why does Christine keep dying?
payoff: The universe disappears, taking Christine with it. Stephen is left alone inside a crystal. He finally undid her death, and lost everything anyway. For more stories like this, subscribe.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: Doctor Strange can reverse time. So why does Christine keep dying?

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: In What If's fourth episode, Christine dies in the crash that should have injured his hands.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Stephen learns magic and defeats Dormammu, but cannot accept her death. So he rewinds their last night.
units.onscreen: HE SAVES THE WORLD. HE CANNOT ACCEPT THE LOSS.
units.visual_query: HE SAVES THE WORLD. HE CANNOT ACCEPT THE LOSS.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Different routes. Different choices. She dies every time. The Ancient One explains: her death made him a sorcerer.
units.onscreen: EVERY ATTEMPT RETURNS TO THE SAME LOSS
units.visual_query: EVERY ATTEMPT RETURNS TO THE SAME LOSS

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Undo that loss, and he destroys the history that gave him these powers. Stephen decides he just needs more.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: For centuries, he absorbs mystical creatures, becoming a monster. But the Ancient One has split him into two selves.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: His other self accepts the loss and tries to stop him. Stephen defeats and absorbs that Strange too.
units.onscreen: THE LAST PERSON WHO COULD STOP HIM
units.visual_query: THE LAST PERSON WHO COULD STOP HIM

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: He revives Christine, but she's terrified. Reality starts collapsing. He begs the Watcher for help, but the Watcher won't interfere.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: The universe disappears, taking Christine with it. Stephen is left alone inside a crystal. He finally undid her death, and lost everything anyway. For more stories like this, subscribe.
units.onscreen: ALL THAT POWER. ONE PERSON LEFT.
units.visual_query: ALL THAT POWER. ONE PERSON LEFT.
